patch_description:
Restore and enhance mid-circuit connectivity based on Prior Program 1's successful pattern. Prior Program 1 achieved 0.91 score with selective RZ rotations on even/odd qubits placed between the forward CZ chain and reverse CRZ chain, resulting in fast convergence (180 steps). Current program has degraded convergence (330 steps) despite 50 parameters.

This edit:
1. Inserts selective mid-circuit RZ rotations (even qubits get rz_mid_a, odd qubits get rz_mid_b) after the forward CZ chain and before the reverse CRZ chain.
2. Adds strategic fixed CZ gates within the reverse chain to strengthen mid-circuit entanglement mixing without adding parameters.

These changes restore the proven mid-circuit phase modulation and connectivity patterns from Prior Program 1, which showed better generalization and faster convergence.
